Exempt from the zero-dirt-start penalty having finished 3rd in his lone dirt sprint outing in May 2025, though his 0-for-16 record and deep closing style face a tough pace setup chasing lone speed #1 Royal Rumor on a Good dirt surface.

all_contenders.name: Unconventional
all_contenders.reason: Danger Horse with second-time starter upside. Ran a strong 87 speed figure in his Oct 16 debut behind #1 Royal Rumor and #2 Soul Force, and carries dirt-capable bloodlines by Audible (son of Into Mischief). Receives the mandatory -12 point penalty for 0 lifetime dirt starts [TUF-to-DIRT RISK], but could easily take a forward step on dirt if he handles the surface switch.
